gen-gf-autour-one-gf-sofia-sans-semi-con: Sofia Sans Semi Condensed reads clean and contemporary, with lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals. And beneath the bold Autour One heading, a full page of it would move along briskly, never tiring the eye.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-nandinagari: Futuristic and tile-like, Audiowide sets the tone up top. Noto Sans Nandinagari brings generous openings and short ascenders, and the pair's real draw is a heading with no thick-thin shift above a body that stays approachable.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-khudaw: Almendra Display brings ornate, literary letters that never seem to pinch shut. Noto Sans Khudawadi is the quieter partner, its rounds left unsealed and its lowercase close to capital height, which is what makes the two fit.
gen-eater-gf-sono: Eater is dark and aggressive, its thin strokes hairline-free beside moderately weighty stems and its letters spaced wide apart. Eater does menace best, while Sono does approachable, tall-bodied text best.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-archivo: Constant, stencil-cut weight runs through every Balsamiq Sans letter. Archivo sits beneath with outward-opening curves and a commanding x-height, taller than the heading's lowercase, so the two trade loose, unpinched curves for editorial firmness.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-fs-asap: Balsamiq Sans draws bold, expressive letters in a constant stencil-cut weight, with no tight, pinched curves anywhere. Asap supplies the readable counterweight, its lowercase nearly matching capital height, which makes the two a confident match.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Be Vietnam Pro shapes its lines like bent steel rod, with curve endings that never crowd each other. Be Vietnam Pro handles tidy, high-set text best, while Balsamiq Sans does bold, stencil-weight heading lines best.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-fs-epilogue: Expressive and bold, Balsamiq Sans holds one stencil-cut weight and never pinches a curve. And Epilogue, with its wire-like monoline skeleton and tall-bodied lowercase, would keep paragraphs running smooth and contemporary.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-fs-fira-sans: Clean s curves that open at both ends and a large x-height make Fira Sans a sturdy partner for Balsamiq Sans. Balsamiq Sans brings the bold flair; Fira Sans brings uniform, steady text.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-fs-merriweather-san: Neutral and clean, Merriweather Sans sets sturdy, large-looking words. Balsamiq Sans above carries bold strokes with no calligraphic swell, and the open-eyed e below keeps the pair sturdy and easy to follow.
